messages:
maria: Heads-up — sketched a Legal Hold escape hatch proposal. Goal: prevent retention deletes, produce forensic-grade evidence export, and give ops emergency controls. Need product + ops alignment before we surface.
kevin: paste the top-level flow so infra impact is clear.
maria: flow: 1) tenant toggles legal_hold (with metadata) 2) system marks events as preserved (exempt TTL) 3) archiver respects preserve flag and can optionally cold-archive but not delete 4) evidence export endpoint creates tamper-evident bundle (signed manifest + object store) 5) revoke unmarks and resumes normal retention.
anya: clarify preserve semantics: never delete vs move-to-cold. cost modeling depends on that.
maria: default preserve = hot for 30d then forced cold-archive but still retained. Provide explicit "hot-preserve" option for short-term holds.
leo: ops: global TTL override touches retention index, archiver, and snapshot pipeline. Backfill for historical items will be heavy — plan migration window.
jordan: auditors need chain-of-custody: signed manifest, monotonic sequence, and region-consistent timestamping.
legal-bot: @maria created PRD with initial manifest schema (see /docs).
kevin: implementation checklist: add tenant hold flag + enforcement in archiver; evidence export job; manifest generation (signed via KMS); ops CLI; runbook for emergency unset.
anya: BYOK customers: exports must be encryptable with customer key or escrowed. The handshake adds complexity (escrow policy + legal acceptance).
maria: decision: GA requires BYOK parity for enterprise customers. For self-serve, document escrow flow and limitations.
leo: SLO notes: when hold active we need retention reporting, cost alerts (preservation budget), and indexing throttles to protect serving.
jordan: UX: admin view shows hold status, case id, issued_by, start/end, and an immutable history. Prevent accidental toggles (confirmation + 2fa).
kevin: manifest header example:
```
{"tenant":"tenant-123","hold_id":"LH-2026-042","issued_by":"legal@cust.com","start":"2026-03-01T12:00:00Z","seq_start":1254321,"signature":"<base64>"}
```
maria: rollout: alpha internal + 2 pilot customers. GA gated on BYOK export option for enterprise, runbook tested, and legal signoff.
anya: acceptance tests: TTL not applied while hold active; export contains all events between start/end; manifest signature verifies via KMS; revoke resumes normal deletion; cost alert triggers when preserved data > threshold.
leo: ops emergency procedure: emergency-unset API requiring 2-person SRE approval, 2FA, and audit-log entry. Include rollback plan.
jordan: multi-region tenants need consistent timestamps. Add monotonic seq numbers per-tenant exported in manifest.
maria: open decisions: BYOK parity for GA? default hot->cold timeline? evidence bundle retention period? emergency unset authority?
kevin: my proposal: require BYOK parity for enterprise GA; default hot preserve 30d then cold; evidence bundles default retention 7y configurable; emergency unset requires 2-person SRE + ticket + manager signoff.
anya: +1 for enterprise BYOK. For smaller customers allow manual escrow documented with clear legal caveats.
maria: tagged as customer-driven — two RFPs asked for legal-hold automation. Next steps: confirm BYOK policy, draft ops runbook, scope a 6-sprint pilot, and surface cost model in the PRD.
legal-bot: Reminder: attach regulatory citations when updating PRD.
kevin: I'll open a tech-spec ticket, invite eng-sre and ops for migration plan.
maria: updating PRD with acceptance tests and UX mocks. Kickoff Friday 10am — ping if you want in. :thumbsup: 
leo: added ops to calendar.
anya: will bring cost model numbers.
jordan: I'll prepare manifest examples for legal review.
kevin: follow-ups: loop #eng-sre, #security, #ops.
maria: end.
